The 2028 US Presidential Election is scheduled to take place on November 7, 2028.

This market will resolve to the person who wins the 2028 US Presidential Election. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No.”

The resolution source for this market is the Associated Press, Fox News, and NBC. This market will resolve once all three sources call the race for the same candidate. If all three sources haven’t called the race for the same candidate by the inauguration date (January 20, 2029) this market will resolve based on who is inaugurated.

eventMetadata.context_description: Early positioning of sitting Vice President JD Vance as the leading Republican contender reflects his institutional role and visibility following the prior cycle, while Marco Rubio's close second-place standing highlights intra-party competition among established figures. On the Democratic side, Gavin Newsom, Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, and Jon Ossoff cluster near double digits amid a fragmented field that includes lower-priced options like Kamala Harris. This spread keeps overall probabilities tight because the 2028 cycle remains far from primary voting, with no dominant polling consolidation or major endorsements yet. Trader consensus prices reflect ongoing uncertainty around candidate viability, potential primary challenges, and general-election matchups. Developments such as 2026 midterm results, early state polling shifts, or formal campaign launches could widen gaps among top names.
